title: Mutate in Place
goal: Multiply all odd numbers in a vector by 3 in place.
hints: &nums yields immutable references. You need a method that yields mutable references.
x is a reference type. You must dereference it before performing arithmetic assignment.
explanation: nums.iter_mut() yields mutable references &mut i32 to each item in the vector. To modify the value behind a reference, dereference it with *x *= 3. Iterating over &nums gives immutable references, producing E0594 when attempting to write. Omitting the dereference operator * causes E0368 because *= cannot operate on reference types directly.
